items.title: How many rate hikes are on tap? Wall Street hopes to connect the Fed’s ‘dots.’
items.description: If the Federal Reserve jacks up interest rates this week to try to tame inflation, investors hope to connect the dots to figure out how much more the central bank will raise borrowing costs.

items.title: Is the shingles vaccine the secret to living longer and delaying dementia? Here’s what the science says.
items.description: A growing body of research suggests Shingrix can reduce the risk of heart disease and delay dementia.

items.title: The 10 most overvalued housing markets in America
items.description: As home prices remain near record highs, about 81% of housing markets in America are overvalued, a new ratings-agency report says, with the Northeast leading the pack.

items.title: 30-year mortgage rate jumps to 7.17% — a nearly 2-year high — in the latest blow to the housing market
items.description: The 10-year Treasury yield crossed a key 5% threshold on Monday, nudging the average 30-year mortgage rate upward.

items.title: Inflation is sinking your high-yield savings account’s returns. Here’s one way to fight it.
items.description: 4% APYs sound good. Too bad inflation is taking a bigger bite out of those yields now.

items.title: Classic budgeting rules don’t work anymore — even if your household makes $100,000. Here’s what does.
items.description: Spending guidelines designed to put diligent consumers in a solid financial position may not set them up to succeed in today’s economy.

items.title: Why one Wall Street firm thinks this year’s stock-market rally is running out of road
items.description: In what may be a first since the early days of the war between the U.S. and Iran, a Wall Street firm is lowering rather than raising its S&P 500 year-end target.

items.title: Pet insurance or savings account: What’s the best way to plan for a big vet bill?
items.description: You want to make sure your pet can receive the care they need when an emergency happens — but is pet insurance the best way to prepare for that?

items.title: Traditional bond investors have lost money for years. These five-star portfolio managers show a better way.
items.description: A fixed-income team at Morgan Stanley say investing in distressed debt and frontier local-market investing have helped drive solid returns for their fund.

items.title: When people with student debt try to save for retirement, they fall behind early and never catch up
items.description: If all employers matched debt payments, workers would save more than $10 billion.
